name: depositFunds
intent: Credit the supplied deposit amount to the current card and record the deposit in the session.
pre: The session password has been validated.
The session card ID has been validated.
A current session card is present.
The deposit quantity is at least 100.
post: Increase the current card balance by quantity relative to its balance before this operation.
Mark the session as having a deposit.
Record quantity as the session deposit amount.
difficulty_basis: Pre-state balance arithmetic plus session transaction state.
scenarios: 1000 plus 100 becomes 1100; deposit markers and result match.
effects_audit: Balance increment, amount, flag and result retained. No denomination/multiple-of-100 rule added.

name: printReceipt
intent: Report the amount associated with the session transaction.
pre: The session card ID has been validated.
The session password has been validated.
A current session card is present.
post: If the withdrawal indicator is set, return the recorded withdrawal amount.
If the withdrawal indicator is not set and the deposit indicator is set, return the recorded deposit amount.
If neither transaction indicator is set, return zero.
difficulty_basis: Three-way return selection with withdrawal priority and authenticated session dependencies.
scenarios: Withdrawal amount 100 agrees with the numeric branch and preserved Real signature.
Deposit amount 200 agrees with the numeric branch.
effects_audit: All three return branches recovered; no printing side effect inferred. Both indicators true is not covered by the current scenarios, but withdrawal priority is explicit in the reference.
